root_cause.text: In `airoha_qdma_rx_process()`, when an error occurs during processing of a non-linear SKB fragment (e.g., payload length mismatch), the page_pool page allocated for that fragment is not returned to the pool because the previous fix conditioned `page_pool_put_full_page` on `q->skb` being NULL, but during fragment processing `q->skb` is already set, leading to a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff removes the `else` condition so that `page_pool_put_full_page` is always called in the error path, regardless of whether `q->skb` is NULL or not. The commit message explicitly states: "the page_pool fragment will not be linked to the skb so it will not return to the pool in the airoha_qdma_rx_process() error path" and that the fix "always running page_pool_put_full_page routine in the airoha_qdma_rx_process() error path." This indicates the root cause was the incorrect conditional that skipped releasing the page when an skb was being built.
